name: PCDPA-CM

prototype.age_missing: finite age >0 and <=120; otherwise outer-train valid median; all-missing fallback 17.0
prototype.site_halves: whole sites assigned greedily to balance per-class counts in each reference subfold; no site crosses halves
prototype.reference_empty_class: exclude unsupported outer-train queries; use D4 fallback for unsupported pair marginals; never use heldout rows
prototype.shuffle: historical condition-shuffle/{site} within-site label-blind derangement; outer-train only; used only for P4 coupling embedding

groups_definition.P1: D4 image CE + paired image CE using real age-sex K + real phenotype D4 CE; no embedding coupling, no KL
groups_definition.P2: P1 with detached real phenotype-embedding similarity C in all three pairwise K relations
groups_definition.P3: P2 without auxiliary phenotype D4 CE or its gradient budget
groups_definition.P4: P3 with only the coupling phenotype embedding permuted by the fixed train-only within-site label-blind derangement

coupling.pair_kernel: H=K_age*K_sex*C; P1 uses C=1; P4 uses z_ph_train[permutation] for C only
coupling.pair_empty_support: beta=0; fallback to D4 class prototype
coupling.pair_loss_support: exactly the historical D4 valid query mask

native_training: Adam, native CE + original graph loss, original validation CE + graph checkpoint selection, original patience, grad-enabled single stochastic test forward
